name: Cabinet Installation
summary: Kitchen, bathroom and storage cabinet installation with layout verification, leveling, fastening, fillers, trim, hardware and coordination with countertops and appliances.

faqs.question: What should be completed before cabinet installation?
faqs.answer: Measurements, layout, wall condition, plumbing, electrical locations, flooring strategy and appliance dimensions should be confirmed before installation begins.

faqs.question: Can new cabinets be installed in an existing kitchen layout?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cabinets can follow the existing layout or be reconfigured when plumbing, electrical, clearances and countertop requirements allow.
